author: SnowSX3
body:
Reported Player(s):  Kaori721
Rules Broken: B2
"You may not intentionally negatively impact your team in any way...Stealing from team members...Griefing team bases and structures."
In this case, crafting tables that are in use by other team mates.

Evidence: http://imgur.com/XtIL6ms,y3Dy74p,7ZinuuR#0
Three images.

This player broke crafting tables that I and other team mates were using.
I obtained the screenshots by pretending to use the crafting tables. This player then broke all of them.
